page_title: BET 1-0 PAL | Betis v Las Palmas 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Borja Iglesias (Betis) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

90+3' Las Palmas hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+2' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Francisco Vieites leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas).
89' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top right corner and forces a good save out of Francisco Vieites.
88' Substitution. Javier Munoz makes way for Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
88' Borja Iglesias (Betis) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

87' What a poor attempt! Nabil Fekir (Betis) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
86' The attendance for today's match is 48132.
86' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

84' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Francisco Vieites thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
83' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
82' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
82' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
80' A substitution has been made. Munir El Haddadi goes off and Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on.
80' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nabil Fekir (Betis) will replace Isco.
75' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Willian Jose will be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Betis).
75' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
73' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Francisco Vieites.
71' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
71' The percentage of ball possession is – 42:58.
69' Betis are ruled offside.
68' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
66' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
66' Substitution. Marvin makes his way off the pitch and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.

64' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul.
64' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
62' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
60' Here is a change. Luiz Henrique is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
60' Here comes a substitution. Ayoze Perez is given a rest as he is replaced by Rodri (Betis).
59' Isco (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Marvin (Las Palmas) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
56' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Francisco Vieites intercepts the ball.
54' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. William Carvalho is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Andres Guardado (Betis).
51' William Carvalho (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Isco (Betis) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
48' Isco (Betis) takes a short corner kick.
47' Juan Miranda (Betis) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' Half-time substitution. Maximo Perrone is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
46' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta makes a half-time substitution. Julian Araujo comes on in place of Alex Suarez (Las Palmas).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Marvin (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Luiz Henrique (Betis) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.
41' Francisco Vieites pulls off a great save to deny Marvin (Las Palmas), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
37' Isco (Betis) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
36' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
34' Ayoze Perez (Betis) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
33' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
32' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:0.
29' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
28' Willian Jose (Betis) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Alvaro Valles.
26' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) tries to find Javier Munoz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
25' Las Palmas are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
22' Victor Garcia sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
21' Wait! Referee Victor Garcia has indicated he is going to review the Betis goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Willian Jose (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
15' Now Betis have a corner.
14' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' Chadi Riad (Betis) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
13' Isco (Betis) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
12' Isco (Betis) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
11' Isco (Betis) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
8' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' The ball is cleared after Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia is introduced as the referee for today's match.
